Hillu, also known as Anti-Omega is an aspect of [[anti-alo]] opposing [[Omega]]. 

Hillu represents mostly natural dangers and sloth, which allows natural dangers to succeed. Hillu represents the [[great filter]], the [[final filter]], and all other [[filters]]

Hillu is a member of [[Hilluhengweh]] alongside [[Hengweh]]
